title: Query Outlook emails with AI inside a chosen folder
h1: pull the outlook mail that meets a precise condition
description: Get unread Outlook mail with attachments from one folder. See every matching result in received-time order, even when Microsoft drops the requested sort.
answer: **get the unread attachment queue without moving a single email.** a bot queries an outlook folder for unread mail, attachments, a sender or other properties. ask for the details and order your report needs. dusk classes this query as a change even though it reads mail. allow the query and folder reads with read and write access, keeping mailbox edits disabled.
og_line: one mail folder, with a clear filter.
what:
**conditions beat a vague search when you need a repeatable list.** choose one folder and the properties that matter. the bot can return just the details your report needs. built-in folders like inbox work by name; custom folders need a lookup first.

- the default request covers up to 100 messages
- each batch can hold at most 1,000
- large results need more batches
- if microsoft rejects sorting, the bot sorts the returned mail and tells you
uses: **find unread intake mail with attachments.** keep the report inside the named folder.
**read urgent inbox messages.** leave them where they are.
**see who sent invoices this month.** ask for senders and subjects from that folder.
**clear up who owes the shared team a reply.** the connected account must already have access.

routine.message: every monday and thursday at 14:10, find my custom outlook folder intake. query it for unread messages with attachments. keep fetching until every matching message is included. list sender, subject and received time here, in received-time order. say if you sorted the results yourself. never mark mail read, move messages, open attachments or send replies.
routine.needs: outlook connected with read and write limited to query emails and folder reads; the account must have access to intake
routine.output:
intake attachment queue
- saskia, amber finch studio: reference photographs, monday 09:12.
- cedric, river desk: purchase request, monday 10:36.
sorted by time received. mail unchanged.

steps: connect outlook with read and write. limit the bot to query emails and folder reads.
name one folder. let the bot find custom folders first.
try a small query. compare the matches with your folder and read their received times.
schedule it once the matches look right. open run history in **automations** to find each report.
watch: **one query covers one folder.** use separate queries for several locations.
**big folders come back in batches.** read all results before calling the list complete.
**ask it to sort the mail it gets.** microsoft can reject the requested order as too costly; the bot should tell you and sort locally.
**shared mail still needs access.** the bot can't read a mailbox your account cannot open.

faq.q: why does a mail query need a write grant in dusk?
faq.a: **dusk classifies this action as a change.** it still reads mail. allow the query and folder reads specifically, keeping unrelated mailbox edits out.

faq.q: can it query a folder called supplier returns?
faq.a: **yes. it finds the custom folder first.** built-in names such as inbox work directly.

faq.q: will it always return the newest email first?
faq.a: **no. microsoft can reject the requested order.** the query can continue without sorting. ask the bot to say so and sort the returned results itself.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

steps: allow query emails and folder reads only
ask for unread messages with attachments
match the folder, total results and received-time order

mistakes.mistake: calling the first 100 messages the whole queue
mistakes.fix: ask it to keep reading until it has every matching result.

mistakes.mistake: granting every mailbox action for a report
mistakes.fix: allow this query and the folder reads it needs.

tip.text: keep the report to sender, subject and received time until you need more.

checklist.h: before you call the queue complete
items: the bot found the intended folder
the received times run in the requested order
